uncited: This family adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for X-ray imaging and radiative physics by replacing view-dependent color with view-independent scalar attributes (density or intensity) [Radiative Gaussian Splatting](3040-radiative-gaussian-splatting.md).

It solves the problem of reconstructing volumetric density fields or synthesizing X-ray projections from 2D attenuation measurements, where physical attenuation depends on integrated density along the ray path rather than surface appearance [Radiative Gaussian Splatting](3040-radiative-gaussian-splatting.md).

Unlike standard 3DGS, which uses spherical harmonics for view-dependent appearance, these methods remove angular dependence to model isotropic radiative transfer [Radiative Gaussian Splatting](3040-radiative-gaussian-splatting.md).

All extensions in this family retain the core 3DGS primitive representation: a set of $M$ anisotropic 3D Gaussian kernels $\mathcal{G} = \{G_i\}_{i=1}^M$ [Radiative Gaussian Splatting](3040-radiative-gaussian-splatting.md).
In radiative and domain-specific variants, this is replaced by view-independent scalar attributes or feature vectors [Radiative Gaussian Splatting](3040-radiative-gaussian-splatting.md).

The family originates from the application of 3D Gaussian Splatting to X-ray tomography, leveraging the differentiable nature of Gaussian splatting to solve inverse problems in medical and industrial imaging.
Radiative Gaussian Splatting introduced the concept of replacing RGB with scalar density for CT reconstruction [Radiative Gaussian Splatting](3040-radiative-gaussian-splatting.md).
X-Gaussian extended this to novel view synthesis and sparse-view reconstruction, highlighting performance advantages over NeRF-based methods [X-Gaussian](4525-x-gaussian.md).

The Radiative Gaussian Point Cloud Model further refined the attribute representation using a Radiation Intensity Response Function to avoid spherical harmonics [Radiative Gaussian Point Cloud Model](5304-radiative-gaussian-point-cloud-model.md).

Volumetric Primitives Radiance Field represents a divergence towards ray-primitive intersection methods for radiance field rendering [Volumetric Primitives Radiance Field](5900-volumetric-primitives-radiance-field.md).
